tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: Channels, optionally filtered by group or a search (name or number).

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: What is on now and next, from the guide, for matching channels.

tools.name: channel_guide
tools.description: One channel's programmes for the next N hours (negative start for catch-up).

tools.name: stream_url
tools.description: The playable URL for a channel, or for a past programme when the channel has catch-up.

tools.name: movies_shows
tools.description: Films and series on an Xtream line (or an M3U's /movie/ and /series/ entries): with nothing else, the categories; with category, its titles; with query, a search of every title; with seriesId, that show's episodes. Films and episodes come with their stream URL.

tools.name: find_subtitles
tools.description: Subtitles for a film or an episode, from OpenSubtitles. Give a title (a provider name like "EN - Film (1999) 4K" is cleaned up) or a tmdbId; for an episode add season and episode (title/tmdbId are then the show). Best match first; fetch one with fetch_subtitle.
